concerns.text: The plan assumes an `exposure_level` variable can be computed as "proportion of comments the user has viewed from identified idealized‑self‑presentation subreddits" (see Phase 1 task 4 and FR‑013). The Pushshift Reddit comment dump only contains comments *posted* by users; it does not record which subreddits or posts a user actually *viewed*. Therefore the required exposure data are not present in the cited dataset, making the planned exposure metric infeasible with this source.

Demographic proxies are to be extracted from Reddit “about” fields via regex (see Phase 4 task 15 and FR‑017). The Pushshift comment dataset does not include user profile metadata such as the “about” section; it only provides comment‑level fields. Consequently, the dataset lacks the necessary demographic information, so the stratified analyses cannot be performed as described.
